levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: Two taḥwīl-free routes meet at موسى الجهني; the text writes مصعب بن سعد and «أبيه» once after the last branch, so they are the shared tail
«أبيه» is the Companion's father-relation: the Companion (Sa'd) is not named in the text, so the relation stays as written
«- واللفظ له -» and the remark «ولم يذكر ابن أبي شيبة...» are gloss and wording, left out; «قال موسى أما عافني» is the saying's own remark
